test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

P. more stringent mobility control and physical distancing policies

Q. East Asian governments (except for Japan) implemented

R. as well as more comprehensive testing, tracing

S. and isolation policies since the early stages
solution:
The correct answer is: **QPRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the parts of the sentence:
 
 
• East Asian governments (except for Japan) implemented
 
• more stringent mobility control and physical distancing policies
 
• as well as more comprehensive testing, tracing
 
• and isolation policies since the early stages.
 
 
 
• The sentence throws light on the fact that since the beginning, East Asian governments (excluding Japan) have put in place stricter rules to control people's movements and maintain physical distance. They have also implemented more thorough policies for testing, tracing, and isolating individuals to effectively manage the situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **QPRS**.
